#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hand-computed unit tests (independent of both simulators)."""
import importlib.util, json, sys

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/work/submission/main.py")
mn = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mn)

fails = []
def check(name, doc, expect_rounds=None, expect_metrics=None, expect_summary=None,
          expect_classes=None):
    try:
        got = mn.run(json.loads(json.dumps(doc)))
    except Exception as e:
        fails.append((name, "EXCEPTION " + repr(e))); print("FAIL", name, "exception", repr(e)); return
    ok = True
    if expect_metrics is not None:
        for k, v in expect_metrics.items():
            if got["metrics"][k] != v:
                ok = False; fails.append((name, "metrics.%s got %r want %r" % (k, got["metrics"][k], v)))
    if expect_rounds is not None:
        if len(got["rounds"]) != len(expect_rounds):
            ok = False; fails.append((name, "round count"))
        else:
            for i, er in enumerate(expect_rounds):
                for k, v in er.items():
                    if got["rounds"][i][k] != v:
                        ok = False; fails.append((name, "round%d.%s got %r want %r" % (i, k, got["rounds"][i][k], v)))
    if expect_summary is not None:
        for k, v in expect_summary.items():
            if got["summary"][k] != v:
                ok = False; fails.append((name, "summary.%s got %r want %r" % (k, got["summary"][k], v)))
    if expect_classes is not None:
        gc = [(c["signature"], c["candidate_count"], c["evidence_rounds"], c["state"]) for c in got["classes"]]
        if gc != expect_classes:
            ok = False; fails.append((name, "classes got %r want %r" % (gc, expect_classes)))
    print(("ok  " if ok else "FAIL"), name)
    if not ok:
        print("   full:", json.dumps(got)[:1200])

def E(u,v,p,a,l): return {"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":p,"ack_us":a,"label":l}
def R(l,t,h,dha=False,dp=None,da=None):
    return {"launch_us":l,"timeout_us":t,"host_delay_us":h,"drop_host_ack":dha,
            "drop_ping":dp or [],"drop_ack":da or []}
def D(n,cap,edges,rounds): return {"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":cap,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}

# --- A: single edge, ACK arrives exactly at deadline -> credited before timeout
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,2,3,"a")],[R(0,5,1)])
check("A ack at deadline", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":5,"source_complete":True,
                      "host_delivery_us":6,"source_proof":[0]}],
      expect_metrics={"host_probe_tx":1,"network_ping_tx":1,"network_ack_tx":1,"host_ack_tx":1,
                      "deduplicated_ping":0,"capacity_drops":0,"late_ping":0,"ignored_ack":0,
                      "allocations":2,"cache_peak":[1,1],"peak_entries":2,"end_us":6},
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":1,"observable_classes":1,"observed_classes":1,
                      "unique_observed_classes":1,"ambiguous_observed_classes":0,
                      "path_evidence_lower":1,"path_evidence_upper":1,"coverage_status":"complete"},
      expect_classes=[(["a"],1,[0],"unique")])

# --- B: same but ACK arrives after deadline (ack_us=4 -> t=6 > 5)
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,2,4,"a")],[R(0,5,1)])
check("B timeout before ack", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":5,"source_complete":False,
                      "host_delivery_us":6,"source_proof":[]}],
      expect_metrics={"network_ack_tx":1,"ignored_ack":1,"allocations":2,"end_us":6,
                      "late_ping":0,"host_ack_tx":1},
      expect_summary={"observed_classes":0,"coverage_status":"no-evidence"})

# --- C: ping at exactly deadline is on time; child dead-end finalizes complete
# n=3: 0->1 (ping 5), 1 has no outgoing edge => dead end
doc = D(3,[2,2,2],[E(0,1,5,1,"a")],[R(0,5,1)])
check("C ping at deadline, dead end", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":5,"source_complete":False,
                      "host_delivery_us":6,"source_proof":[]}],
      expect_metrics={"network_ping_tx":1,"network_ack_tx":1,"allocations":2,
                      "ignored_ack":1,"late_ping":0,"end_us":6},
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":0,"observable_classes":0,"coverage_status":"no-routes"})

# --- D: late ping (arrives after deadline)
doc = D(3,[2,2,2],[E(0,1,6,1,"a"),E(1,2,1,1,"b")],[R(0,5,1)])
check("D late ping", doc,
      expect_metrics={"late_ping":1,"network_ping_tx":1,"allocations":1,
                      "network_ack_tx":0,"ignored_ack":0},
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"source_final_us":5,"source_complete":False,"source_proof":[]}])

# --- E: capacity drop of host ping -> not started; release still scheduled
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,5,1),R(0,5,1)])
check("E host capacity drop", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True},{"id":1,"started":False,"source_final_us":None,
                      "source_complete":None,"host_delivery_us":None,"source_proof":[]}],
      expect_metrics={"host_probe_tx":2,"capacity_drops":1,"host_ack_tx":1,"allocations":2,
                      "peak_entries":2,"cache_peak":[1,1],"end_us":6})

# --- F: dedup: two parents into one node; second ping dedups, single forward
# 0->1(a),0->2(b),1->3(c),2->3(c),3->4(d)
edges=[E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(0,2,1,1,"b"),E(1,3,1,1,"c"),E(2,3,1,1,"c"),E(3,4,1,1,"d")]
doc = D(5,[4,4,4,4,4],edges,[R(0,20,1)])
check("F dedup shared suffix", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True,"source_complete":True,"source_proof":[0,1,2,3,4]}],
      expect_metrics={"deduplicated_ping":1,"network_ping_tx":5,"network_ack_tx":5,
                      "allocations":5,"ignored_ack":0,"late_ping":0,"peak_entries":5},
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":2,"observable_classes":2,"observed_classes":2,
                      "unique_observed_classes":2,"coverage_status":"complete"})

# --- G: dedup against an already-finalized entry triggers cached ACK retransmit
# node 3 (dead-end-ish) finalizes fast; a later duplicate ping gets the cached ack.
# 0->1 ping1 ; 1 is dest? use n=2 with two edges impossible (no parallel).
# Build: 0->1 (ping 1), 0->2 (ping 1), 1->3(ping 1), 2->3 (ping 5) so node3 allocates
# at t=2 via edge 2, finalizes (dead end if 3 is dest)
edges=[E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(0,2,1,1,"a"),E(1,3,1,1,"b"),E(2,3,5,1,"b")]
doc = D(4,[4,4,4,4],edges,[R(0,50,1)])
# node3 is dest: allocated at t=2 (via edge2), finalized immediately, ack to parent edge2.
# ping via edge2 (from node2) -> wait: node2 allocated at t=1, transmits ping on edge3 at t=1
# arriving t=6 -> node3 already has entry (allocated at t=2 via edge2 from node1) -> dedup + cached ack
got = mn.run(json.loads(json.dumps(doc)))
check("G cached ack to late duplicate", doc,
      expect_metrics={"deduplicated_ping":1,"network_ack_tx":3,"ignored_ack":0,
                      "allocations":4,"network_ping_tx":4},
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"source_complete":True,"source_proof":[0,1,2,3]}],
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":2,"observable_classes":1,"observed_classes":1,
                      "ambiguous_observed_classes":1,"unique_observed_classes":0,
                      "path_evidence_upper":2,"coverage_status":"complete"})

# --- H: drop_host_ack -> no evidence but proof still reported
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,20,1,True)])
check("H dropped host ack", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":2,"source_complete":True,
                      "host_delivery_us":None,"source_proof":[0]}],
      expect_metrics={"host_ack_tx":1,"end_us":21},
      expect_summary={"observed_classes":0,"coverage_status":"no-evidence","observable_classes":1})

# --- I: lost ping on the only edge -> source times out, incomplete
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,20,1,False,[0])])
check("I lost ping", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"source_final_us":20,"source_complete":False,"host_delivery_us":21,
                      "source_proof":[]}],
      expect_metrics={"network_ping_tx":1,"network_ack_tx":0,"allocations":1,"late_ping":0,
                      "end_us":21,"peak_entries":1},
      expect_summary={"observed_classes":0,"coverage_status":"no-evidence"})

# --- J: lost reverse ack -> source incomplete, proof empty
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,20,1,False,[],[0])])
check("J lost reverse ack", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"source_final_us":20,"source_complete":False,"source_proof":[]}],
      expect_metrics={"network_ping_tx":1,"network_ack_tx":1,"allocations":2,"ignored_ack":0,
                      "end_us":21})

# --- K: no rounds at all
doc = D(3,[1,1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(1,2,1,1,"b")],[])
check("K no rounds", doc,
      expect_metrics={"host_probe_tx":0,"end_us":0,"peak_entries":0,"cache_peak":[0,0,0]},
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":1,"observable_classes":1,"observed_classes":0,
                      "coverage_status":"no-evidence"})

# --- L: no edges at all
doc = D(3,[1,1,1],[],[R(0,5,2)])
check("L no edges", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":0,"source_complete":True,
                      "host_delivery_us":2,"source_proof":[]}],
      expect_metrics={"host_ack_tx":1,"allocations":1,"network_ping_tx":0,"end_us":6},
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":0,"observable_classes":0,"coverage_status":"no-routes"})

# --- M: source capacity 0 -> not started
doc = D(2,[0,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,5,1)])
check("M source capacity zero", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":False,"source_final_us":None,"host_delivery_us":None}],
      expect_metrics={"capacity_drops":1,"host_ack_tx":0,"allocations":0,"end_us":6})

# --- N: partial evidence -> signature subset only
edges=[E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(0,2,1,1,"x"),E(1,3,1,1,"b"),E(2,3,1,1,"b")]
doc = D(4,[4,4,4,4],edges,[R(0,50,1,False,[2,3])])  # drop pings on edge 2 and 3
check("N partial proof", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"source_complete":False,"source_proof":[0,1]}],
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":2,"observable_classes":2,"observed_classes":0,
                      "coverage_status":"no-evidence"})

# --- O: two rounds, same launch, capacity forces ordering by round id
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,5,1),R(0,5,1),R(0,5,1)])
check("O three rounds capacity one", doc,
      expect_metrics={"capacity_drops":2,"host_ack_tx":1,"allocations":2,"peak_entries":2,
                      "cache_peak":[1,1]},
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"started":True},{"id":1,"started":False},{"id":2,"started":False}])

# --- P: staggered rounds, evidence only from delivered round
edges=[E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(1,2,1,1,"b")]
doc = D(3,[2,2,2],edges,[R(0,50,1,True),R(10,50,1)])
check("P lost then delivered", doc,
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"host_delivery_us":None,"source_proof":[0,1]},
                     {"id":1,"host_delivery_us":52,"source_proof":[0,1]}],
      expect_classes=[(["a","b"],1,[1],"unique")],
      expect_summary={"observed_classes":1,"coverage_status":"complete"})

# --- Q: ambiguous class ordering and prefixes: signatures ["a"], ["a","b"]
edges=[E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(1,2,1,1,"b")]
# n=3 dest=2: only path 0->1->2. add a direct edge 0->2 label "a" so class ["a"] and ["a","b"]
edges=[E(0,2,1,1,"a"),E(0,1,1,1,"a"),E(1,2,1,1,"b")]
doc = D(3,[3,3,3],edges,[R(0,50,1)])
check("Q class ordering prefix first", doc,
      expect_classes=[(["a"],1,[0],"unique"),(["a","b"],1,[0],"unique")],
      expect_summary={"topology_paths":2,"observable_classes":2,"observed_classes":2,
                      "coverage_status":"complete"})

# --- R: end_us driven by a late host ack
doc = D(2,[1,1],[E(0,1,1,1,"a")],[R(0,5,10000)])
check("R host ack after release", doc,
      expect_metrics={"end_us":10006},
      expect_rounds=[{"id":0,"host_delivery_us":10006}])

print()
if fails:
    print("FAILURES:", len(fails))
    for f in fails: print(" -", f)
    sys.exit(1)
print("all unit tests passed")
PYEOF
cd /work && python3 tmp/dev/units.py
